steps.text: At your door ❤️
AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
Do I get to put this down first?
The bag, yes. You, no.
She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
You remembered what you said last night.
I did.
Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
This one?
I thought you'd like it.
I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
Make yourself at home.
You might regret telling me that.
You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
Can we try another race?
Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
No comments from the instructor, please.

You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
You're much quicker through that section now.
I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
In the game or on the sofa?
Both.
{{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
Another round?
In a bit. Stay here with me first.
Gladly.
45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
